question: Which other classes of celestial beings appear within the revealed cosmic vision?
premises: Yakshas, Nagas, and Vidyadharas are named.
These beings are part of the vision.
inference: The revealed vision also includes Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakshas, Nagas, and Vidyadharas.
plain_english: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakshas, Nagas, and Vidyadharas, O beloved.
